translations.ko: 이것은 아담 계보의 기록이다. 하나님이 사람을 창조하실 때, 하나님의 모습을 따라 그를 만드셨다.
translations.en: This is the record of Adam’s descendants. When God created humankind, he made them in the likeness of God.
translations.es: Este es el registro de la descendencia de Adán. Cuando Dios creó al ser humano, lo hizo a semejanza de Dios.

translations.ko: 그들을 남자와 여자로 창조하시고, 그들을 창조하신 날에 복을 주시며 그들의 이름을 사람이라 부르셨다.
translations.en: Male and female he created them, and he blessed them and named them Humankind when they were created.
translations.es: Varón y mujer los creó, los bendijo y los llamó Ser humano cuando fueron creados.

translations.en: Adam lived one hundred thirty years and fathered a son in his likeness, according to his image, and named him Seth.
translations.es: Adán vivió ciento treinta años y engendró un hijo a su semejanza, conforme a su imagen, y lo llamó Set.

translations.en: After fathering Seth, Adam lived eight hundred years and fathered sons and daughters.
translations.es: Después de engendrar a Set, Adán vivió ochocientos años y engendró hijos e hijas.
